semiconductor_relevance: High — The company produces ultra-pure high-purity chemical reagents essential for semiconductor applications.
summary: Zhejiang Shangneng Industrial Co., Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of high-end electronic chemicals in China, specializing in ultra-pure high-purity chemical reagents. Their products are critical for semiconductor applications, including discrete devices, integrated circuits, photovoltaic cells, TFT-LCDs, and LEDs.

regional_presence.China: Operates one of the largest production bases for wet electronic chemicals with a capacity of 100,000 tons.
